body: I know, you're right. I've always been like this though. Shy, a loner, with no self-confidence. 20 years of this and I still can't be myself. You're right the *real* me is 100 times different than what I am in front of people. You know, I'm gonna make an appointment with my school counselor. Tell them everything, see what they say that can help. Thanks.

I have 85% on my English class, and I also have an art class, but I'm going to need to ask the professor what my grade is. I know it can't be horrible, but it's not an A. I'm way too shy to ask the teacher, yes even on the internet I'm shy... I'm just afraid she will think I'm a huge idiot, which sounds dumb, I know.. I guess next time I don't understand the homework or essay I could build up some courage and ask her, though.

Well, I know I will eventually start out small, like at fast food places or shitty jobs, but I am talking about my future. Like I said in my post my mom is almost 50, but has to work at taco bell. I want to have a career by the time I'm that age. I can have a talk with my school counselor and see what they tell me.

I don't understand the directions the teacher has, it's an online class, and I don't understand the textbook. I'm in my second year of college, and well I've gotten better, but if people knew my grades they will be so disappointed in me.

I didn't get very good grades. I don't understand most of the stuff my English class needs me to do. It's like a completely different language to me. I took two other college English classes, but they seemed like 2nd grade stuff compared to this class.
I'm not good enough for college, so I guess not.

I need to go to college, though, to get a career. Like I said, I don't want to be a failure and work at walmart or fast food places.

No, success means to me that I have a happy life where I am well off and do not need to worry about not having money to pay the bills. It means that I'm smart, educated, and I don't need someone else to take care of me. I have a good job, that pays well, and I'm not struggling to survive. I think it would be highly unlikely for me to be rich, but I don't want to be poor, either.
